column3: Close to the Greek.

NASB renders “bounty” as “gift” and reorders the verse.
NASB renders “suitable” as “fitting.”

NASB adds “cause to be.”

NASB adds “our” and renders “exhorted” as “encouraged” and “will” as “desire.”
